locations.name: Bahen 1F
locations.brief_description:
You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. There is an elevator going up to CSSU Room, and ways to UT Bookstore, 
Robarts Library, Morrison Hall and Chestnut Residence. You see something shiny on the ground -- looks like a toonie?
locations.long_description:
You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. 
Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. You better not disturb them. One student is rushing down the corridor, 
wearing a heavy-looking backpack and carrying a textbook in their arms. There is an elevator going up to CSSU Room, and ways to UT Bookstore, 
Robarts Library, Morrison Hall and Chestnut Residence.

locations.name: CSSU Room
locations.brief_description:
You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. There is an elevator to the first floor, and look to the left, you see a mysterious room 
–- is that CSSU, a magical place for desperate CS students?

locations.name: Chestnut Residence
locations.brief_description:
You are in the Chestnut Residence and you meet up with your study partner Park, he might know where is your lucky mug is. 
Or you are not in a good mood in a conversation, you can choose to leave. There are ways to UT Bookstore, Morrison Hall, 
Bahen Center and Gerstein Center
locations.long_description:
You are in the Chestnut Residence, a place you have only been once. The unfamiliar environment makes you feel a little bit nervous. 
The place is also quit and with only sound of students playing pool, you feel a little bit better. Suddenly, 
you see your study partner Park, it might be a good idea to talk to him... There are also ways towards west -- to UT Bookstore, 
towards North -- to Gerstein Centre, towards northwest --  to Bahen Center and ways towards Morrison Hall, in the Northwest.

locations.name: Morrison Hall Lobby
locations.brief_description:
You are in the Morrison Hall. There are ways to your room, or you can leave the building. 
There are ways along the St. George Street to Robarts Library to northwest, to Bahen Center to southwest, way to Gerstein from UC, 
and also way to direcly go to Chestnut residence.
locations.long_description:
You are in the Morrisno Hall, the place you have been living for the last couples of months, 
it is not sun set yet, the sunlight shines through the window and splashes on the ground, but you don't have the time to stop and appreciate the scene, 
you are still carrying a heavy task on your shoulder. Maybe you want to go to your room or you think you might leave the building to do some actual work. 
There are ways along the St. George Street to Robarts Library to northwest, to Bahen Center to southwest, way to Gerstein from UC and also way to Chestnut residence.

locations.name: Your Room
locations.brief_description:
You are in your room. You see your wallet and tcard lying on the table, besides your died laptop. 
You can leave the room whenever you want.
locations.long_description:
You are in your room, the cozy and comfortable place only belongs to your own. 
You look at the bed, maybe it is not a good time to have a nap now... Your wallet and laptop are on the table, you cross your fingers, 
hoping there is some money in the wallet, so you can buy some drink for tonight. 
This is your place, you can stay or leave at whenever you want.

locations.name: UT Bookstore
locations.brief_description:
You are in the UT Bookstore. You can walk around and check what things to buy. There is an 
exit leading to Bahen Center(2 min) and Chestnut Residence(10 min).
locations.long_description:
You are in the UT Bookstore. With all kinds of UT-theme clothes on the hangers, it will be 
delightful to stop by and try them on. A few students passed by you, with textbooks they bought, 
and hurried out of the store. They remind you of your project, it's time to do what you are supposed to do. 
You can go around to check what you can buy, or there is an exit leading to Bahen Center(2 min) and Chestnut Residence(10 min).
